fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Matterhorn REST API key generated in the customer panel (free for registered wholesale customers), sent as the raw Authorization header value.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Order currency for create_order (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP); left out of the body when unset.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe reads the category dictionary with the key.

list_products.note: GET /B2BAPI/ITEMS/?page=&limit= (100 per page by default, 1000 at most); `category` is category_id (GET /B2BAPI/DICTIONARIES/CATEGORIES), `query` is not accepted. Each product carries prices in many currencies (prices{EUR, USD, GBP, ...}; EUR is mapped as price_eur) and variants[{variant_uid, name (size), stock}] - variant_uid is what orders need.

get_product.note: GET /B2BAPI/ITEMS/{id}: {id, name, description, color, category_path, brand, stock_total, url, images[], variants[{variant_uid, name, stock, max_processing_time, ean}], prices{EUR, CHF, CZK, USD, GBP, ...}}. `price` is the EUR wholesale price; other currencies are in `raw`.prices.

create_order.note: PUT /B2BAPI/ACCOUNT/ORDERS/ places a wholesale order (it is not paid through the API: pay via the returned payment_url or the confirmation e-mail link). `items` are [{variant_uid, quantity}]; `shipping_address` is Matterhorn's delivery_to {first_name, second_name, country (2-letter, lower case), street, house_number, zip, city} - when omitted Matterhorn ships to the key owner's address; `shipping_option` is the numeric delivery_method_id from GET /B2BAPI/DICTIONARIES/DELIVERY/{country}.

get_order.note: GET /B2BAPI/ACCOUNT/ORDERS/{id}: {id, order_date, status, total_net, total_gross, tax, order_currency, shipping_service, shipping_number and invoice_number (after dispatch), tracking_url, payment_url, delivery_to, positions[{product_variant_uid, quantity, grossprice, status}]}.

not_offered.quote_shipping: Delivery methods per country come from GET /B2BAPI/DICTIONARIES/DELIVERY/{country}, but the api-help page does not document its response fields (the SwaggerHub reference it points to is not linked readably), so the options cannot be mapped reliably.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; the order carries shipping_service, shipping_number and tracking_url once shipped (see get_order).
